steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title using the product's generated unique title.
Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the saved terms configuration visible

steps.note: Configure the event-wise clauses and their Required/None modes, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one available QA vendor for the bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Confirm the Required clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Submit a quote of 100 for the line item; successful submission proves the unaccepted optional clause does not block bidding.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
